title: Join Erin at Impact Week 2026
subtitle: Learn the art of non-reactivity and letting go
description: Learn the art of non-reactivity and letting go
body_html:
I am once again hosting a few mindfulness sessions at Impact Week this year.

These themes are curated around a single, quiet skill — the pause. Not the productivity kind, where you stop only to briefly catch your breath before diving back in, but the deeper kind that lets you notice an impulse before you act on it, and discern a pressure before you agre…
